summary.text: John Martin is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 44, who assumed office on January 8, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Martin owns Pro Pumping and Hydrojetting, LLC.

paragraphs.text: John Martin earned a bachelor's degree in political science and economics from Southwest Baptist University and a graduate degree in theology from the Midwestern Baptist Theological Seminary.
His career experience includes owning Pro Pumping and Hydrojetting, LLC.
In the Missouri House, Martin was assigned to the Budget Committee, the House Economic Development Committee and the Elementary and Secondary Education Committee for 2025-2026.
